title: Ahmed Zabana: The First to Climb the Guillotine
description: The true story of Ahmed Zabana, Algerian freedom fighter, executed on June 19, 1956 at Barberousse prison. Verify dates against official sources.
style: Cinematic historical documentary still, 1950s black and white 35mm film photography, heavy grain, high contrast, soft vignette, dust and scratches, desaturated, vertical 9:16, no text, no modern elements, no recognizable faces

clips.image_prompt: Dawn over rural western Algeria, mist on the fields, mud-brick village, distant shepherd silhouette
clips.narration: In 1926, near Oran, a poor boy was born under French rule. His name was Ahmed Zabana.

clips.image_prompt: Young Algerian man in 1950s clothes seen from behind in a narrow old street, looking up at the sky
clips.narration: He grew up watching injustice every day, and chose to join the secret struggle for Algeria's freedom.

clips.image_prompt: Prison cell, thick iron bars, one beam of light from a high window
clips.narration: When the revolution began in November 1954, he fought in the Oran region.

clips.image_prompt: Tall man's shadow standing upright on a stone cell wall, face hidden in darkness
clips.narration: Captured, he was sentenced to death by a colonial court. In his cell, he wrote a final letter to his family.

clips.image_prompt: Long dark prison corridor, a heavy iron door slightly open, light spilling in, no people visible
clips.narration: At dawn on June 19th, 1956, the iron door opened inside Barberousse prison, in Algiers.
clips.caption: June 19, 1956

clips.image_prompt: Empty stone courtyard before dawn, still air, faint light on the walls, nobody visible
clips.narration: Together with his comrade Abdelkader Ferradj, he walked toward the guillotine.

clips.image_prompt: Dawn sky above old stone walls, flock of birds rising into soft light
clips.narration: He was the first Algerian fighter executed by guillotine in the revolution. But the struggle did not die with him.

clips.image_prompt: Algerian flag waving slowly against a bright sky, seen from below, strong wind, proud mood
clips.narration: Ahmed Zabana was thirty years old. He died so that Algeria could live.
clips.caption: Algeria remembers
